definitions.short: Cham , a son of Noah; also (as a patronymic) his descendants or their country
definitions.full: H2526. Cham I. חָם proper name, masculine person and location (compare Sabean חם Hal 243 ) — ᵐ5 Ξαμ : — 1 Ham, 2nd son of Noah Gen 5:32 ; 6:10 ; 7:13 ; 9:18 (twice in verse); 1Chr 1:4 ; called father of Canaan Gen 9:22 and of various peoples 10:1 , 6 , 20 ; 1Chr 1:8 , compare שָׁם הַיּשְׁבִים מִןחָֿם 4:40 ; these peoples were inhabitants of southern lands, or related historically or politically to such inhabitants; see מּוּט מִצְרַיִם, כְּנַעַן, כּוּשׁ, , etc. 2 in late Psalms a name (collective) for Egyptians: — ׳אָֽהֳלֵיחֿ Psa 78:51 ; ׳אֶרֶץחֿ 105:23 ; 105:27 ; 106:22 (all || מִצְרַיִם , except 105:27 ). — On historical significance, and attempts at etymology see Di Gen. ed. 6, chap.10 , especially pp. 165, 168 f., Hom SV i. 427 Bu Urg. 323 Wied Ägypt. Geschichte. i. 22 .

The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.
